objects.name: How Adversaries Are Turning the Vulnerability Ecosystem Against Defenders
objects.description: A comment : 3% of ‘critical’ software security bugs, in all of recorded history, have been found in the last month. This is on pace to find another ~100,000 bugs this year alone, adding ~26% more vulnerabilities to the all time total Do you realize how fucking insane that is? It is a new world out there.
